title: Single Execution Authority Rule
program: J Merrill Publishing Automated Marketing Operating System

classificationLegend.designed: Architecture/rule defined in this package or prior canon.
classificationLegend.implemented: Runtime, table, app, or scheduler exists and has been observed or deployed.
classificationLegend.proven: End-to-end execution evidence exists with authoritative external/readback proof.

rule: Each platform destination for a social post may have exactly one active execution authority at a time.
prohibited: Sintra plus Meta for same FB/IG post
Sintra plus LinkedIn native for same LinkedIn post
API plus browser scheduler for same platform execution
